capabilities: Search movies and series using the note name
Write title details and streaming availability as note properties
Refresh a note directly via its tmdb_id and Type properties
Filter results by country and chosen streaming services
Save poster images into the vault
disambiguation: Not a live-streaming or screen-recording tool; it looks up which subscription services currently carry a given movie or series.
extras: The API has free and paid tiers. The README also documents a Title stats view (with CSS variables and data attributes for restyling) and a Jellyfin watch-history integration; the Demo section is empty.
problem: Notes about a film or show do not record where it can currently be watched, so availability has to be checked service by service by hand.
